name: research-skills
description: Claude Code plugins for academic research and development: literature search, grant writing and review, manuscript preparation, scientific figures, presentations, project lifecycle management, and neuroinformatics

plugins.name: project
plugins.description: Project lifecycle toolkit: initialization, rule/config updates, epic/sprint workflow, CI/CD scaffolding, Docker packaging, security auditing, and document processing

plugins.name: grant
plugins.description: Grant proposal toolkit: NIH/NSF writing with mechanism-specific templates, structured review with scoring criteria, and figure quality assurance

plugins.name: manuscript
plugins.description: Academic manuscript toolkit: literature review (multi-phase citation-traceable + single-pass thematic), peer review, writing, and journal-specific formatting for submission

plugins.name: opencite
plugins.description: Academic literature search, citation management, PDF retrieval, identifier conversion, and BibTeX export

plugins.name: scientific-figures
plugins.description: Publication-quality scientific figures: icons, plots, react-pdf composition, and visual QA for Nature/Science/PNAS journals

plugins.name: presentation
plugins.description: Presentation builder: create interactive Reveal.js presentations from JSON with Mermaid diagrams, LaTeX math, code highlighting, and animated reveals

plugins.name: neuroinformatics
plugins.description: Neuroscience data standards and experiment design: BIDS conversion/validation, HED annotation, and PsychoPy experiment scaffolding
